newsitem.title: USA: Caribbean plan seen in trade bill in fall-Gingrich.
newsitem.headline: Caribbean plan seen in trade bill in fall-Gingrich.

text.p: The Caribbean Basin Initiative may be included in fast-track trade legislation this fall, House Speaker Newt Gingrich said Friday.

Gingrich said he favors the Caribbean trade plan designed to give those countries similar provisions as the North American Free Trade Agreement. "I would hope it will be in fast-track legislation this fall, I believe in it," he said.

The White House had wanted the Caribbean Basin Initiative added to the tax bill that passed Congress Thursday, but would not agree to Republican reform proposals for Amtrak as a trade-off so it was not included.
